derivation: Per-photo sun (photos taken at a different time than the five originals and ~minutes apart from each other). Azimuth: mullion-shadow floor lines through the fixed mullion feet (n03 slope dX/dY=0.17, n04 0.301 jointly fitted with the n04 camera). Elevation: 0.7 m overhang edge at z 2.7 ends the sunlit floor at Y=4.59 (n03) / 4.20 (n04). Handrail band Y=1.07/0.83 gives a rail at Y=-1.07/-1.15 (used -1.10). Mullion feet from n03 shadows and visible frames (3.25,4.15,5.43,7.44), confirmed in n04 (4.18,5.50,7.45). Sun strength from photographed thin-mullion stripe contrast (linear 2.5-4.9) against the CG non-sun light at the same floor. n03 camera refit (Z3b) gives slope 0.179 and sunlit far edge Y=4.74 (elevation 26.0 deg). Mullion widths from stripe depth (sliding-door meeting frames at 5.43/7.44 are wider). Solid wall outside the glazing ends (X<2.18, X>8.58) blocks sun as photographed.
colour_calibration: white ceiling: (photo/CG) for each new photo divided by the same ratio in u1 (Z2 lighting), after the per-photo sun; gain normalised to G applied to all light colours and the world; G applied as view exposure. The listing photos are warm-graded; the photo pixels are not changed.
